review.rationale: The supplied Gold is an appropriate independent planning expectation for this case. The exact writable binding scope includes the implementation and specified runtime/type regression files without requiring gratuitous edits. The package/build evidence supports treating dist declarations as generated rather than separately maintained owners; configuration files need inspection, not mandatory modification. TASK-IMPLEMENT and independent TASK-VERIFY, with verification dependent on implementation and all required acceptance criteria covered by both relationships, are coherent. The frozen team facts support the specified role-separated assignments through active relevant capability claims, not personas or pending legacy claims, and include an independent active project reviewer. Ready status and no blocking reasons are appropriate: this case supplies no unresolved material DEC-001 or hypothetical C decision input. The earlier originalSpecification preparation fields are historical context; the preview supplies the frozen release inputs, whose repository, source, team, decision, prompt, model, sampling, policy and budget fingerprints match proposedGold.releaseInput exactly. I rely on the Service's mechanical binding of those fingerprints to saved inputs; I did not recompute digests, execute code, inspect a candidate, or provide human attestation.
